date: Zoho Setup text read 16 Nov 2026; live test 9 Nov 2026 (techsolutionsegypt)
title: Zoho Desk round robin threshold: what is counted (Setup text + live test)
rows: Setup text (Round Robin page tips, 16 Nov)

"...equally distribute the tickets among the available agents by taking into account their current workload ... You can also set the agent threshold, to limit the number of tickets they can solve while the other tickets will wait in the queue."
Round Robin Preferences > Department wise threshold
"Maximum number of open tickets an agent in the department can handle at any given time."
Agent: 1 Open in rule dept + 2 Open in another dept; dept threshold 2
Ticket #108 assigned -> only the rule's department is counted
Agent: 2 Open in rule dept; threshold 2
Control #109 stays Unassigned (waits) -> count = the agent's real Open tickets
#108 set On Hold, new matching ticket
Never seen: Zoho counted exactly the agent's own Open tickets of that department in all 3 checks
